description.narrative: Purpose of the trip is to study the possibility of building up a future co work and fellowship between the AKBU youth in Denmark and the Youth Department of the Apostolic Church in Togo (YDAC). Since 2005 there has been a strong relationship between The Apostolic Church of Denmark and a Togolese partner organization TED - “Togolese engaged for development”, but never involving our respective youth organizations. The aim of this preparatory study project is having a mutual introduction of the partners in North and South and to see if there is a way to cooperate. If so, steps will be taken to study the circumstances of Togolese teenagers and youth specifically in the many villages in Togo in cooperation with the Togolese youth organization. And to explore the possibilities to strengthen the teenagers and youth in the villages by building up local groups for fellowship through gatherings and hereby using football as an activity and in the future other types of sport. We will also study the possibility of making joint national gatherings in Togo for the exchange of Danish and Togolese trainers and leaders.
